# Game Idea: **Orb Runner**

- **Genre:** Endless runner / arcade
- **Controls:** Arrow keys (←/→ to rotate ship, ↑ to thrust)
- **Goal:** Keep the ship moving forward through an infinite starfield, avoid obstacles, and survive as long as possible.
- **Obstacles:** Randomly spawned asteroids and laser barriers that move toward the player.
- **Power‑ups:** Temporary shields or speed boosts appear occasionally.
- **Lose Condition:** Colliding with any obstacle (asteroid or laser) ends the game.
- **Implementation:** All visuals rendered on an HTML5 `<canvas>` using simple 2‑D physics and sprite drawing.

*The game fits within a single HTML page with a canvas element and can be built with plain JavaScript.*

1: // Simple endless runner based on IDEA.md
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
8:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
9: 
10:   // ----- Audio setup -----
11:   // Simple synth beep generator
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function beep(freq, duration) {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.type = 'sine';
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     osc.start();
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24: 
25:   // Background ambient sound (looped)
26:   const bgAudio = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/johnsmith1001/space-sounds@main/ambient.mp3');
27:   bgAudio.loop = true;
28:   bgAudio.volume = 0.2;
29:   // Collision / crash sound
30:   const crashAudio = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/johnsmith1001/space-sounds@main/crash.mp3');
31:   crashAudio.volume = 0.4;
32:   // Start after a user interaction (required by browsers)
33:   const startAudio = () => {
34:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
35:     bgAudio.play();
36:     window.removeEventListener('keydown', startAudio);
37:     window.removeEventListener('click', startAudio);
38:   };
39:   window.addEventListener('keydown', startAudio);
40:   window.addEventListener('click', startAudio);
41: 
42:   // ----- Ship -----
43:   const ship = {
44:     x: W / 2,
45:     y: H * 0.8,
46:     r: 15,
47:     angle: 0, // radians
48:     vx: 0,
49:     vy: 0,
50:     thrust: 0.1,
51:     rotateSpeed: 0.07,
52:   };
53: 
54:   // ----- Starfield -----
55:   const stars = [];
56:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
57:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1 });
58:   }
59:   function updateStars() {
60:     for (const s of stars) {
61:       s.y += 1.5; // speed of forward motion
62:       if (s.y > H) {
63:         s.x = Math.random() * W;
64:         s.y = 0;
65:         s.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
66:       }
67:     }
68:   }
69:   function drawStars() {
70:     // draw glowing stars as circles
71:     for (const s of stars) {
72:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(s.x, s.y, 0, s.x, s.y, s.size);
73:       gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)');
74:       gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
75:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
76:       ctx.beginPath();
77:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
78:       ctx.fill();
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   // ----- Obstacles -----
83:   const obstacles = [];
84:   const OBSTACLE_FREQ = 120; // frames
85:   let frameCount = 0;
86:   function spawnObstacle() {
87:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
88:     const x = Math.random() * (W - radius * 2) + radius;
89:     obstacles.push({ x, y: -radius, r: radius, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
90:   }
91:   function updateObstacles() {
92:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const o = obstacles[i];
94:       o.y += o.speed;
95:       if (o.y - o.r > H) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
96:     }
97:   }
98:   function drawObstacles() {
99:     for (const o of obstacles) {
100:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r);
101:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(200,200,200,0.9)');
102:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(100,100,100,0.4)');
103:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
104:       ctx.beginPath();
105:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
106:       ctx.fill();
107:     }
108:   }
109: 
110:   // ----- Input -----
111:   const keys = {};
112:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
113:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
114: 
115:   // ----- Game state -----
116:   let running = true;
117:   let score = 0;
118: 
119:   function reset() {
120:     ship.x = W / 2;
121:     ship.y = H * 0.8;
122:     ship.vx = ship.vy = 0;
123:     ship.angle = 0;
124:     obstacles.length = 0;
125:     frameCount = 0;
126:     score = 0;
127:     running = true;
128:   }
129: 
130:   function checkCollision() {
131:     for (const o of obstacles) {
132:       const dx = ship.x - o.x;
133:       const dy = ship.y - o.y;
134:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
135:       if (dist < ship.r + o.r) return true;
136:     }
137:     return false;
138:   }
139: 
140:   function updateShip() {
141:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
142:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
143:     if (keys.ArrowUp) {
144:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
145:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
146:       // thrust sound
147:       beep(440, 0.04);
148:     }
149:     // apply velocity
150:     ship.x += ship.vx;
151:     ship.y += ship.vy;
152:     // simple friction
153:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
154:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
155:     // keep inside canvas
156:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = W;
157:     if (ship.x > W) ship.x = 0;
158:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = H;
159:     if (ship.y > H) ship.y = 0;
160:   }
161:   function drawShip() {
162:     ctx.save();
163:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
164:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
165:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
166:     ctx.beginPath();
167:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.r);
168:     ctx.lineTo(ship.r * 0.6, ship.r);
169:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r * 0.6, ship.r);
170:     ctx.closePath();
171:     ctx.fill();
172:     ctx.restore();
173:   }
174: 
175:   function loop() {
176:     // draw space background gradient
177:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
178:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
179:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
180:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
181:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
182:     updateStars();
183:     drawStars();
184:     if (running) {
185:       if (frameCount % OBSTACLE_FREQ === 0) spawnObstacle();
186:       updateObstacles();
187:       drawObstacles();
188:       updateShip();
189:       drawShip();
190:       if (checkCollision()) {
191:         running = false;
192:         crashAudio.currentTime = 0;
193:         crashAudio.play();
194:       }
195:       score++;
196:     } else {
197:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
198:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
199:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
200:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Score: ' + score, W / 2, H / 2);
201:       ctx.fillText('Press Space to Restart', W / 2, H / 2 + 30);
202:       if (keys[' ']) reset();
203:     }
204:     frameCount++;
205:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
206:   }
207: 
208:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
209: })();

(End of file - total 209 lines)
</content>
